description: Educational quantum computing app with 5 learning modes: circuit composer puzzles, MCQ concept checks, fill-the-gate challenges, circuit reading analysis, and measurement probability labs.
notes: Update completed_levels and pending_goals after each session. All level IDs are 1-based (level 1 = allQQLevels[0]). Videos released for composer levels 1–23: DO NOT renumber or change those levels. New level types are appended after index 45 (level 46). All 116 tests pass. Zero analyzer errors.

architecture.level_model: lib/models/qq_level.dart — sealed class QQLevel with 5 subclasses: ComposerLevel, McqLevel, FillTheGateLevel, CircuitReadingLevel, MeasurementLabLevel. All have optional fields: title, conceptIntro, solutionExplanation, hints[].
architecture.level_list: lib/models/qq_levels.dart — allQQLevels[] (0-based indices, level ID = index+1). groupedLevels[] maps category names to index ranges. Currently 54 total levels.
architecture.routing: lib/screens/home_page.dart — _screenForLevel() uses sealed-class switch to route each level type to its screen. _showCategoryIntroIfNeeded() fires once per category (SharedPreferences key: intro_seen_{groupName}).
architecture.simulation_engine: lib/models/quantum_circuit.dart — takes ComposerLevel, builds gate matrices, runs simulation. Used by all level types via ComposerLevel.fromBinaryString() or levelType.toComposerLevel().
architecture.key_widgets: lib/widgets/quantum_circuit_painter.dart (circuit renderer), lib/widgets/state_vector_display.dart (amplitude list with show-all toggle)

level_index_map.note: from/to are 0-based indices into allQQLevels. Level ID shown to user = index + 1.

composer.description: Interactive circuit builder. Users drag-and-drop gates onto qubit lines to match a target state vector. Supports 1–3 qubits, all standard gates (X/Y/Z/H/S/T/CX/CZ/CCX/Rx/Ry/Rz), pre-inserted gates, and a free sandbox mode.

conceptIntro dialog shown automatically before puzzle starts
level title shown as subtitle in home-screen grid button

mcq.description: Multiple-choice concept checks. No circuit interaction. Each level has a question, 4 options, correctOptionIndex, optional conceptIntro and solutionExplanation. Correct answer unlocks next level; wrong answer routes back to level select.

level_content.48: What is Entanglement? (product vs. entangled state)

fill_the_gate.description: Shows a text schematic of a partially-built circuit with a '?' blank. User picks the correct gate from 4 coloured options. Answer is verified by running the full simulation via FillTheGateLevel.toComposerLevelWith(gate).

level_content.51: Fill: Create |+⟩ — blank is the only gate, correct answer is H
level_content.52: Fill: Flip the Bit — |1⟩ → |0⟩, correct answer is X

known_limitations: toComposerLevelWith() inserts the selected gate at circuit.maxCircuitDepth() on qubit 0 — works only for single-qubit levels where the blank is the last gate. FillTheGateLevel has no blankPosition/blankQubit fields yet.
Circuit display is a text schematic (monospace ASCII), not the real QuantumCircuitPainter

circuit_reading.description: Shows a complete pre-built read-only circuit rendered by QuantumCircuitPainter. User identifies the output state from 4 LaTeX-rendered options. Answer checked by correctOptionIndex (no simulation needed).

level_content.54: H then CNOT on |00⟩ — options: |00>, Bell Φ+, Bell Ψ+, |11>  (correct: Bell Φ+)

measurement_lab.description: User presses 'Measure' N times on a pre-built circuit state. Each tap runs a probabilistic collapse of the state vector (Born rule). A live histogram shows outcome frequencies converging to true probabilities. Level unlocks after requiredMeasurements taps.

level_content.50: Bell state Φ+ — expect ~50/50 |00⟩ / |11⟩, never |01⟩ or |10⟩

key_files.lib/models/qq_level.dart: Sealed class hierarchy for all level types. Edit here to add fields to any level type.
key_files.lib/models/qq_levels.dart: Master list allQQLevels[] and groupedLevels[]. Add new levels here. CAUTION: do not change indices 0–22 (videos released).
key_files.lib/models/qq_levels_category.dart: Category model with optional categoryIntro string.
key_files.lib/models/quantum_circuit.dart: Core simulation engine. Takes ComposerLevel. Builds gate matrices and applies to state vector.
key_files.lib/models/quantum_matrix.dart: Matrix operations: tensor product, dot product, almostEqualTo for solution checking.
key_files.lib/models/selected_gate_type.dart: Gate enum + Gate class with color/label/angle. Add new gate types here.
key_files.lib/screens/home_page.dart: _screenForLevel() sealed switch for routing. _showCategoryIntroIfNeeded() for category intros.
key_files.lib/screens/quantum_composer.dart: Main circuit puzzle screen. Drag-and-drop gates onto QuantumCircuitPainter.
key_files.lib/screens/mcq_screen.dart: MCQ screen. Animated options, concept intro banner, solution explanation.
key_files.lib/screens/fill_the_gate_screen.dart: Fill-the-gate screen. Text schematic + 4 gate tiles. Simulation-verified answer.
key_files.lib/screens/circuit_reading_screen.dart: Circuit reading screen. Read-only QuantumCircuitPainter + 4 LaTeX state options.
key_files.lib/screens/measurement_lab_screen.dart: Measurement lab. Probabilistic collapse engine + live histogram.
key_files.lib/widgets/quantum_circuit_painter.dart: CustomPainter for circuit diagram. Used in composer and circuit_reading_screen.
key_files.lib/widgets/state_vector_display.dart: Scrollable list of |ket>: amplitude pairs with show-all toggle.
key_files.test/levels_test.dart: Tests all 46 ComposerLevels against expected solution vectors, plus 18 tests for non-composer levels 47–54 (MCQ structure, MeasurementLab simulation, FillTheGate correct/wrong-gate checks, CircuitReading structure and simulation), plus 21 title tests (1 exhaustive all-54 parametric + 20 exact-string spot-checks one per category group). 85 tests total.
key_files.test/quantum_circuit_test.dart: 77 unit tests for QuantumCircuit internals (gate insertion, simulation, matrix math).
